title: pricing-exception-telemetry-and-autogovernance-pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success currently request one-off discounts and custom billing terms via ad-hoc channels. There is limited telemetry tying approved exceptions back to pricebook versions, billing configuration, and security questionnaire triggers. This causes lost visibility into realized unit economics, delayed audits, and occasional unapproved discounts slipping through.

Goal: Build an automated governance pipeline that (1) captures every discount exception request with structured metadata, (2) computes a risk-and-cost score, (3) routes for the appropriate approval path, (4) records the final decision in the pricebook and billing config, and (5) surfaces telemetry in the Console and Finance dashboards for ongoing monitoring and retroactive audits.

Scope: MVP covers the most frequent exception types (one-off % discounts, multi-year seat price overrides, trial-to-paid conversion credits). Integrations: Salesforce/CRM (request capture), internal approvals service (RBAC and sign-off), billing system (apply final ratecard), Console (telemetry dashboard), and Security Questionnaire (SQ) service to flag sensitive deals that require legal/Security review.

Non-goals: Changes to base pricebook schema, global discount policy edits, or new billing engine architecture during MVP. Those are follow-ups once telemetry proves the control loop.
acceptance_criteria: All exception requests created via the CRM webhook include structured metadata: reason, requested_discount_pct, deal_value, customer_tier, sq_flag.
Automated risk-and-cost score calculated and persisted; score thresholds map to approval lanes (Sales Lead, Finance, Legal+Security).
Approval workflow enforces RBAC and records sign-offs; disallowed paths are blocked programmatically.
Approved exceptions are written to the canonical pricebook change log and the billing system receives a reconciled rate update via the billing-change API.
Console dashboard surfaces: exception volume by team, realized revenue delta, approval latency, and top customers by exception frequency.
Audit export (CSV) available for Finance/Security that joins exception records with final invoice line-items for the previous 90 days.
